description: flywheel: at session start, load the learnings ledger and surface the loop commands; before a file read, advisorily surface any prior learnings that touch it; before a file write or a bash command, pre-approve writes to flywheel's own state dir (.claude/flywheel/**) and single loop-advancing git commands (add/commit/stash, force-free push of the current feature branch) so the loop's spec/plan approvals aren't re-asked as tool permission prompts; at stop, run the project's opt-in verification gate; before opening delegated work — a child session or a subagent — ask when its tier, its context or its very existence has not been decided (no `model`, no effort named, no anchor to read, a pasted contract, a re-delegated issue or a fan past four), and after it is created record it so the duplicate and width checks count facts rather than intentions; at session start also widen a shallow single-branch clone's fetch refspec, so pushing a new branch creates its tracking ref and pushed work stops reading as unpushed.
